chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim and Hafs ibn al-Bakhtari and others, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Concerning this verse: 'Allah erases what He wills and establishes,' he said: 'Does He erase other than that which was established? And does He establish other than that which was not?'
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of Allah erasing and establishing in the context of Bada'?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the concept of Bada' by interpreting the verse 'Allah blots out or establishes what He wills' through precise logical distinctions. He posits that 'blotting out' (Mahw) necessarily implies the prior existence of a decree, while 'establishing' (Ithbat) refers to the introduction of something new, thereby affirming that divine knowledge can manifest changes in the cosmic record. This explanation is foundational in Shia theology for reconciling divine omniscience with the occurrence of new events.

en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/360] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham b. Salim and Hafs b. al-Bakhtari and others apart from them both from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام that he (the Imam) said concerning the verse: “Allah erases what He wills and establishes” [13:39] -
Does He erase other than that which was established (before)? And does He establish other than that which was not there (at all)?
